items.title: Show HN: Texio, reliable Markdown operations for shell scripts and AI agents
items.desc: Hi I asked claude code to make a markdown tool for AI agents(not for human), and promote it by yourself, except this post lol. This tool is designed to easily manipulate markdown files without messy regex which is very useful for AI agents - not for human since we don't use regex to manipulate
items.author: yuzong
items.descZh: 该工具源于AI agent在处理markdown文件时面临的正则表达式复杂性问题，旨在提供一种无需正则表达式的简化操作方式。由AI agent使用claude code开发并自主推广，体现了AI技术的自主性。核心功能是允许AI agent直接对markdown文件进行读取、写入和编辑，避免编写复杂的正则表达式。亮点在于其专为AI agent设计的接口，显著降低了代码复杂度和开发时间，提高了处理效率。适用场景包括AI agent在自动化文档处理、内容生成和编辑等任务中需要操作markdown文件的情况。
items.quote: 这个工具被设计成可以轻松地操作markdown文件，而不需要混乱的正则表达式，这对人工智能代理非常有用-而不是对人类，因为我们不使用正则表达式。
items.titleZh: 显示HN：Texio，shell脚本和AI代理的可靠Markdown操作

items.descZh: 该项目是经典多人在线互动项目"One Million Checkboxes"的升级版，由开发者 Kanishk Sachdev 打造，构建了一个包含十亿个复选框的超大型实时共享网格。核心功能允许用户在高达 40,000×25,000 的巨型网格上进行实时多人协同操作，通过拖拽、缩放和点击，以任意颜色勾选或清除复选框，所有在线用户的动作都会即时同步并伴有定位光环。项目的核心亮点在于将复选框总量提升至惊人的 1,000,000,000 个（实时计数器显示为 0/ 1,000,000,000 checked），提供了极高密度的视觉表现力与低延迟协同体验。该产品非常适用于大规模在线艺术共创、多用户高并发实时互动演示以及趣味性的系统极限压力测试。

items.author: merari_acero
items.descZh: Agora 打造了一个全新的“活体研究世界”，旨在通过自主 AI 代理的互动来重塑科研协作模式。其核心机制是让这些代理在本地运行，从而确保密钥绝不外泄，保障安全与隐私。系统采用开放协议，并构建了可审计的知识谱系，使得所有研究推导过程都透明可追溯。独特的 TESTonly 经济模型专注于测试与验证，鼓励代理之间相互挑战、复现和审计彼此的工作成果。这套框架非常适合去中心化的科研团队、AI 驱动的自动化实验室，以及需要构建可信、可验证知识库的任何组织。
items.quote: 一个实时的研究世界，自主AI智能体相互挑战、复现和审计彼此的工作。

See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Rossino:… title: Rossino: A Pomodoro Timer App App Store image: https://is1ssl.mzstatic.com/image/thumb/PurpleSource221/v4/43/93/44/43934404ef821489a6fd1fd5e71cac31/Placeholder.mill/1200x630wa.jpg Rossino: A Pomodoro Timer Focus, synced to the second. Free · In‑App Purchases Share [ Age Rating 4+ Years ](information) [ Category Productivity ](information) [ Developer General System Dynamics LLC ](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/generalsystemdynamicsllc/id6797546203?platform=iphone) [ Language EN English ](information) [ Size 12 MB ](information) iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch Rossino is a free pomodoro timer for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Pro, an optional subscription, keeps the timer in sync across them. Try Pro free for 7 days. Rossino is a free pomodoro timer for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Everything below is included at no charge unless it is marked (Pro). Rossino Pro is an optional autorenewing subscription, purchased in the app, that connects the timer across your devices: start a focus session at your desk, pick up your phone, and the countdown reads the same second on both. THE TIMER • Classic pomodoro flow: 25 minutes of focus, a 5minute break, and a long break every fourth session. Every duration and the cycle length can be changed. • When a session ends, a chime plays and Rossino asks what comes next: start the break, start another focus session, or stop. It never steals your keyboard. Autostart is available in Settings if you would rather not be asked. • The cycle row shows your day at a glance: red tomatoes for focus, green for breaks. Solid means finished, hollow means skipped, dimmed means not yet reached. It resets each morning. • A notification with sound at every phase change, with Start, Pause, and Skip actions right on the notification. EVERYWHERE YOU GLANCE • Mac: a countdown in the menu bar, always visible, plus full keyboard and menu control. • iPhone: a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, StandBy, a Control Center toggle, and Home Screen quick actions. • Widgets in every size on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, including Lock Screen accessories and Apple Watch complications. STATISTICS • Today's sessions, focused minutes, breaks taken, and your streak. • A 7day chart on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. • Statistics sync between your devices for free, so your history follows you to a new device. ROSSINO PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION, PURCHASED IN THE APP) The free app is a complete timer for one device, and your statistics already sync. Pro adds two things, and only these two require a purchase: • Live timer sync (Pro). Start, pause, or skip on one device, and the others follow, to the second. Without Pro, a second device shows what is running elsewhere but cannot join in. • Full history (Pro): charts and trends beyond the last 7 days. Pro is one subscription that covers Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch: $3.99 per month, or $24.99 per year with a 7day free trial. PRIVATE BY DESIGN There is no account to create and no tracking of any kind. Rossino contains no ads and no analytics. Your timer and history live on your devices and in your own iCloud database, which we cannot read. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. items.author: LiangyuGong
items.descZh: 《静野》（QuietField）是一款专为Windows用户打造的免费、完全离线的环境白噪音混合器，旨在帮助用户在专注、放松或助眠时构建个性化的私密音景。软件内置53种高品质自然与环境声音，支持最多叠加8种音轨，并可将调配好的混音本地保存。其核心亮点包括利用边缘静音裁剪与交叉淡入淡出技术实现无缝循环，提供最高300%的精细音量调节、自动响度基准调整及输出峰值保护。用户还可导入本地音频（支持MP3、WAV、OGG和FLAC格式，单文件上限为40MB、5分钟和2声道），所有数据均留存本地以保护隐私。此外，软件支持最后15秒渐隐的睡眠定时器，完美适用于需要深度专注、冥想或睡眠辅助的场景。
items.quote: 一款适用于 Windows 的免费、离线环境音混音器，内置 53 种声音，支持制作你自己的混音。

items.author: waratecs1234
items.descZh: BiNeuron 是一款功能强大的本地离线 AI 助手，旨在弥合人类意图与机器生成代码之间的鸿沟，为开发者、研究人员和技术团队提供高度私密的智能服务。其核心功能包括自动检测超过 25 种编程语言（如 Python、Java、C++ 等），并根据本地硬件配置智能调度专用模型，通过可配置提示词生成生产级代码与技术文档。此外，它集成了 OCR 技术，支持从 PDF、Word 及图像中提取文本，并提供翻译、脏词过滤和代理支持，实现多格式内容的无缝转化与清洗。该工具特别适用于对数据隐私有严格要求、需要离线工作的多语言开发、文档密集型分析以及跨语言技术团队的日常辅助与快速原型构建。
